page_name: Zodiac MyStamp Folder (Horse) with Spring Decorative MyStamp Sheet (MYHRSFDL)
description: Usher in the Chinese New Year with SingPost's Year of the Horse collection! This exclusive collection features a MyStamp sheet showcasing a Horse pulling a cart laden with gold ingots, with stamp tabs dedicated to each of the 12 Zodiac animals. Also included is a decorative Spring MyStamp sheet, highlighted by the auspicious Chinese character "财" (cái), which signifies "wealth," "fortune," and "riches," symbolizing material abundance and prosperity. Begin your annual tradition and collect a new zodiac animal MyStamp folder every Chinese New Year.
